title: Picture tags in the video prompt
notes:
- Video inputs: every picture shows its tag (@Image1, @Image2 ...) and the clip shows @Video1. Hover an input to see it larger, with its tag
- Video prompt: tags are marked in your text. Hover a tag to see its picture, type @ to pick one
- Picture numbers pasted from other tools become our tags, and we ask you to check them. A tag without a picture stops the take and says which one
- A reference you name for the location, the light or the look is no longer treated as the car
- The assistant writes these tags too
